mcqs.question: What is the definition of inertia?

options.A: Tendency of an object to resist change in its state of motion
options.B: Force required to start motion of an object
options.C: Speed of an object in a given direction
options.D: Energy stored in a moving object

mcqs.answer: Tendency of an object to resist change in its state of motion
mcqs.explanation: Inertia is the property of matter that makes it resist any change in its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by an external force. Option A states this definition correctly; the other options describe different concepts such as force, speed, or kinetic energy.

mcqs.question: If a book is lying on a table and remains at rest, which statement best describes its inertia of rest?

options.A: It will stay at rest unless acted upon by an external force
options.B: It will start moving on its own after some time
options.C: It will roll down the table due to its inertia
options.D: It will change shape spontaneously because of inertia

mcqs.answer: It will stay at rest unless acted upon by an external force
mcqs.explanation: Inertia of rest means an object at rest tends to remain at rest unless a net external force acts on it. Option A captures this idea. Options B, C, and D are misconceptions; inertia does not cause spontaneous motion, rolling, or shape change.

mcqs.question: How does inertia of motion differ from inertia of rest?

options.A: Inertia of motion keeps a moving object in motion, while inertia of rest keeps an object at rest
options.B: Inertia of motion stops moving objects, whereas inertia of rest starts objects moving
options.C: Both types cause objects to accelerate without any force
options.D: Neither type is related to the object's state of motion

mcqs.answer: Inertia of motion keeps a moving object in motion, while inertia of rest keeps an object at rest
mcqs.explanation: Inertia of motion resists any change to the velocity of a moving object, so it tends to continue moving. Inertia of rest resists any change to the state of rest. Option A correctly distinguishes the two; the other options misstate the effects of inertia.

mcqs.question: A car moving straight suddenly tries to turn left sharply. Which aspect of inertia is responsible for the car's tendency to continue moving straight?
mcqs.explanation: Inertia of direction (a component of inertia of motion) makes a moving body resist a change in its direction of travel. Hence the car tends to keep moving straight. Inertia of rest applies to stationary objects, while gravity and friction are external forces, not aspects of inertia.

mcqs.question: Which of the following everyday situations best illustrates inertia of motion?

options.A: A passenger lurches forward when a bus suddenly stops
options.B: A ball rolls uphill without being pushed
options.D: Water boils spontaneously in a closed container

mcqs.answer: A passenger lurches forward when a bus suddenly stops
mcqs.explanation: When the bus stops abruptly, the passenger's body tends to continue moving forward due to inertia of motion. The other options describe unrelated phenomena (gravity, magnetism, phase change).

mcqs.question: A soccer ball remains motionless on the field until a player kicks it. Which statement correctly defines the property shown by the ball before it is kicked?

options.A: Inertia – the ball’s resistance to change its state of rest
options.B: Momentum – the ball’s tendency to keep moving
options.C: Acceleration – the ball’s change in speed
options.D: Force – the push applied by the player

mcqs.answer: Inertia – the ball’s resistance to change its state of rest
mcqs.explanation: The ball staying at rest exemplifies inertia of rest, which is the resistance to a change in its state of rest. Momentum and acceleration involve motion, and force is the external agent that changes the state.

mcqs.question: A student believes that a stationary object will eventually start moving on its own because of its inertia. Which response correctly addresses this misconception?

options.A: Inertia of rest means the object will stay at rest unless acted upon by an external force
options.B: Inertia causes objects to move spontaneously without any force
options.C: Objects at rest have no inertia
options.D: Inertia only applies to objects that are already moving

mcqs.answer: Inertia of rest means the object will stay at rest unless acted upon by an external force
mcqs.explanation: The correct principle is that inertia of rest keeps an object at rest until a net external force acts. Options B, C, and D misinterpret inertia, leading to the student's misconception.

mcqs.question: Why does a moving skateboard continue to glide forward even after the rider stops pushing, assuming negligible friction?

options.A: Because of inertia of motion, which resists a change in its state of motion
options.C: Because the rider’s muscles keep pushing it
options.D: Because magnetic forces act on the skateboard

mcqs.answer: Because of inertia of motion, which resists a change in its state of motion
mcqs.explanation: In the absence of significant external forces, inertia of motion keeps the skateboard moving at constant velocity. Gravity acts vertically, not horizontally; the rider is no longer applying force, and magnetic forces are irrelevant.
